-- Data Warehouse
DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20221231  --299740798657.05062000000
 
SELECT SUM(BalanceAmountFull) BalanceAmountFull, ACCOUNTID
FROM [DW].[FactDepositsOutstandingBalance_TEST_20231108] a
WHERE BusinessDateSK = @BusinessDate and 
AccountID IN 
(SELECT BCPB.CustomerAccountID FROM bnkm.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TEST_20231107  BCPB
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON CAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCPB.CustomerAccountId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON FPA.FinancialProductId  = CAFP.ProductId  AND FPA.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%') AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
and BCPB.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' 
AND @BusinessDate BETWEEN CONVERT(CHAR(8),BCPB.PeriodStartDate,112) AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),BCPB.PeriodEndDate,112))
GROUP BY ACCOUNTID
order by 1 DESC

DECLARE @BusinessDate as INT = 20221231;  --299834762581.15492000000
 
WITH CustomerAccountPeriodBalance
AS (
    SELECT * FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountPeriodBalance_TEST_20231107
    WHERE PeriodBalanceTypeId = 'EOD Running Balance of Transaction Date'
    AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' AND @BusinessDate BETWEEN CONVERT(CHAR(8),PeriodStartDate,112) AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),PeriodEndDate,112) 
    --and customeraccountid ='90eb1bcc7723b8b82f4bb7f60e08223a'
),

CurrencyConversion AS (
SELECT * FROM BNKM.CurrencyConversion_FillGapDates WHERE ConvertToCurrencyId = 'PHP' AND RateId = 'REV' AND CONVERT(CHAR(8),CurrencyConversionTimestamp,112) =20221231
)
 
SELECT
SUM(CASE WHEN BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode <> 'PHP' THEN ISNULL(BCPB.BalanceAmount,0) * ISNULL(CC.ConversionRate,0)
    ELSE BCPB.BalanceAmount END ) AS BalanceAmountFull
    ,BCPB.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
FROM CustomerAccountPeriodBalance BCPB
LEFT JOIN CurrencyConversion CC ON BCPB.IsoCurrencyCode = CC.ConvertFromCurrencyId AND BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId = CC.FinancialInstitutionId AND convert(varchar,@BusinessDate) = CC.CurrencyConversionTimestamp
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct CAFP ON CAFP.CustomerAccountId = BCPB.CustomerAccountId AND CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId = BCPB.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.FinancialProductApplication FPA ON FPA.FinancialProductId  = CAFP.ProductId  AND FPA.FinancialInstitutionId = CAFP.FinancialInstitutionId
WHERE CAFP.ProductId NOT LIKE ('09%') AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
GROUP BY BCPB.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID
order by 1 desc
